files.installs/sotf/worldcradle-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed Sons of the Forest server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/sotf/worldcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/sotf/worldcradle-servers/test/dedicatedserver.cfg" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def put(keys, val):
    obj = d
    for k in keys[:-1]:
        obj = obj.setdefault(k, {})
    obj[keys[-1]] = val
put(['Password'], join)
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-wc-sotf-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/sotf/" || exit 1
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 640x480x24 -nolisten tcp" wine ./SonsOfTheForestDS.exe -userdatapath "Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\sotf\\worldcradle-servers\\test"
